'''Charles Hickey''' (also known as '''Charlie''' and '''Charley'''; GEMP handle '''Teacher''')<ref name="retro-gempc-86781">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86781 Player List for 2026 Retro GEMPC], forum.starwarsccg.org (14 June 2026). [[:File:SWCCG forum t86781 Player List for 2026 Retro GEMPC.txt]]</ref> won [[2022 Retro League Event 3|Event 3 of the 2022 Retro League]].<ref name="p1382408" /> Hickey also finished '''#20''' at the [[2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]] and '''#58''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (lost Round of 64; Challonge seed 58).<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026/ 2026-09 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)], starwarsccg.org (published 10 September 2026).
